title: Sunday School
body:
Registration for the new school year opens on Sunday 9/13, We start at 11:15 AM

Level 1: Covers the Arabic alphabet and Books 1 & 2 of Islamic Studies.

Level 2: Covers Books 3 & 4 of Islamic Studies and Quran reading.

Level 3: Covers the Seerah (focusing on the manners of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ) and the proofs of Islam.
